tagline: A walk-around demo: a two-storey suburban house with furnished rooms and a fenced garden full of trees and flowers.
overview:
The House Demo is one of RedEngine's example scenes: a place to look around rather than a game to win. It is a suburban house, open inside, with a hall, a living room and a study, a porch and front walk, and a large fenced garden with trees, hedges, flowerbeds, a patio and a garden shed.

You walk around it in first person (Q switches to third person) carrying the baseball bat every RedEngine player starts with. There are no goals, scores or timers. It is a good place to see the engine's lighting, shadows and furniture models, or to host a session and wander around with friends.
story: No story: it is an ordinary family house on an ordinary sunny afternoon, with nobody home. It was built as a showcase for the engine's houses, gardens, trees and furniture, and as a quiet place to try out walking around.
goal: There is no goal and no way to win or lose: explore.
rules: Walk anywhere inside the house and the fenced garden.
Your bat can knock loose objects around.
Nothing is scored and there is no time limit.
